articles.title: Canal+ n’obtient pas gain de cause face à Cloudflare sur le blocage des sites pirates de F1 et de MotoGP
articles.summary:
Trois sites pirates bloqués sur vingt et un : c’est le bilan que Canal+ dressait pour la Formule 1, et trois sur seize pour le MotoGP. La chaîne en avait tiré une demande, 50 000 euros par jour et par site resté accessible, à payer par Cloudflare. Le 17 septembre, le tribunal judiciaire de Paris a rejeté les deux demandes, ainsi que les 20 000 euros de frais de justice réclamés, comme l’a révélé L’Informé.
Tout part de deux jugements du 17 avril lorsque le tribunal avait ordonné à Cloudflare de bloquer l’accès depuis la France à 21 noms de domaine diffusant la F1, jusqu’à la dernière course du 6 décembre, et à 16 autres pour le MotoGP, jusqu’au 22 novembre. Le délai était de trois jours après signification, et le moyen laissé libre : « tout moyen efficace ».
Un blocage par le CDN, pas par le DNS
Cloudflare a agi par son seul CDN, le service qui relaie et protège les sites : un site pirate client de ce service devient inaccessible en France. Elle n’a rien fait via 1.1.1.1, son résolveur DNS public, une sorte d’annuaire du web. Selon Canal+, deux des trois sites bloqués étaient de nouveau accessibles une semaine plus tard, l’un après un changement de CDN, l’autre via un site miroir.
Le tribunal ne tranche pas la question du DNS et relève simplement que Cloudflare soutient que l’architecture de 1.1.1.1 ne permet pas de bloquer, et que ce serait déraisonnable. Pour les sites qui changent de CDN ou ouvrent un miroir, il juge que Cloudflare n’en est pas responsable : c’est à Canal+…

Why small businesses can’t afford to treat cybersecurity as an afterthought
Bitdefender Ultimate Small Business Security could be the cybersecurity co-worker to help you succeed
For a growing small business, cybersecurity can often feel like one of those problems that belongs to larger companies with dedicated security teams.
But cybercriminals have no interest in company headcount - they are hunting for valuable data, accessible accounts and opportunities to turn a single mistake into a financial payoff, which makes cybersecurity a business priority, not simply an IT concern.
The risks will hopefully sound familiar: phishing emails, fake invoices, stolen passwords, ransomware, payment fraud and attempts to hijack business accounts, as attackers look to exploit employees and everyday business processes rather than needing to defeat sophisticated technical defences.
AI is giving cybercrime a serious productivity boost
But now there is an additional force making these threats harder to ignore: artificial intelligence.
Generative AI has obvious benefits for legitimate businesses, but the same capabilities can be turned against them, as criminals can use AI to produce convincing messages at scale, personalise phishing attempts and automate parts of an attack that previously required significant manual effort.
Europol has warned that generative AI is already being used to supercharge social engineering, enabling criminals to tailor scam messages to victims' personal and cultural c…

articles.title: Hackers hit European supermarket refrigeration systems, spoiling food and forcing stores to dump stock
articles.summary:
In a nutshell: Cyber attackers are causing major headaches for grocery shoppers across Europe. On Sunday night, hackers targeted refrigeration systems at around 150 Intermarché stores, forcing employees to toss out food that is no longer safe to consume. And that's only the tip of the iceberg.
A spokesperson for the supermarket chain told Bloomberg that attackers infiltrated controls for the cooling systems and activated the defrost mode, which heated them to 50 degrees Celsius, or 122 degrees Fahrenheit. Roughly six hours passed before employees noticed. By that time, all of the food in the coolers had been ruined.
The attack wasn't limited to Intermarché stores. According to Agence France-Presse, fewer than 100 Cooperative U stores were also hit. BMF added that some Leclerc stores were also impacted. La Dépêche reports that electronic pricing label systems were also impacted.
Bloomberg said the systems targeted in the Intermarché attack were managed by Danfoss. Just a few months back, security researchers with Team 82 published a report highlighting multiple vulnerabilities in Danfoss refrigeration controllers that could lead to this exact sort of attack. It is no surprise, then, that an attack materialized in the real world.
The immediate fallout from the attack isn't fully clear, outside of the obvious inconvenience to shoppers, supermarket employees, and food suppliers. Early reports pin the financial loss at around 300,000 euros, but that figure could climb much higher …

articles.title: Norway fines Microsoft ad firm $9.6 million over Grindr data sharing
articles.summary:
Norway’s Data Protection Authority (Datatilsynet) has fined Xandr, a Microsoft-owned advertising company, $9.6M (NOK 92 million) for unlawfully processing and sharing sensitive data belonging to Grindr users in the country.
The data protection authority said this is the largest fine it has ever issued.
“We issued such a high fine in this case because the breaches we identified were very serious,” said Line Coll, Director General of Datatilsynet.
“Thousands of users in Norway have been subjected to unlawful sharing of their sensitive data.”
According to the authority’s findings, between July 2018 and April 2020, Xandr managed real-time advertising auctions inside Grindr that potentially exposed users’ data, including sensitive sexual orientation information, to thousands of companies.
These auctions work by advertisers bidding for the right to display an ad to a Grindr user after they receive profiling information from Xandr, which acted as the intermediary.
At the time, Xandr was a joint controller with Grindr, meaning it was responsible for how the data was used and should have required and obtained explicit consent from the data subjects for this processing.
Grindr is a location-based dating app primarily serving the LGBTQ+ community.
According to Norway's data privacy agency, Xandr assumed Grindr had obtained valid consent but did not take any action to verify it.

Despite deploying so many robots, Amazon is also the second-largest corporate employer in the world, with more than 1.5 million full-time and part-time human workers, according to its 2025 annual report. Amazon executives say that the growing robot fleet has eased the burden on its human workforce by taking on the toughest fulfillment center tasks that carry the greatest risks of physical fatigue and injury. But labor advocacy groups and independent researchers point to evidence suggesting that warehouse automation driven by AI is not all upside for the humans who work alongside robots.

articles.title: Sanyark Space is building low Earth orbit satellites for high-precision navigation and communications
articles.summary:
Sanyark Space is building low Earth orbit satellites for high-precision navigation and communications
Founded by former ISRO scientists, Sanyark Space is developing satellites to provide centimetre-level navigation accuracy and direct satellite-to-device connectivity.
Modern autonomous navigation, high-speed mobility, and critical infrastructure rely heavily on satellite positioning and timing. But conventional navigation systems such as GPS, Galileo, and NavIC transmit signals from medium Earth or geostationary orbits, tens of thousands of kilometres away.
These signals weaken before reaching the ground, making them vulnerable to atmospheric disturbances, electronic jamming, and spoofing.
Existing satellite navigation systems generally provide an average accuracy of around five metres. That margin of error is too wide for Level 2+ driver assistance systems, which handle functions such as steering and lane-centring, or for determining whether a vehicle is travelling on a highway or an adjacent service road.

The startup was incorporated in July 2025 by two former scientists from the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO).

articles.title: L’étrange paradoxe : comment une IA chinoise d’Alibaba permet à Microsoft de casser ses prix

Avec Microsoft-Decision-1, le géant américain veut réduire le coût des petits arbitrages qui font tourner les applications. Ce modèle bâti sur une IA chinoise vise les développeurs et les entreprises qui cherchent à automatiser le tri, la vérification ou l’orientation des demandes.
La nouvelle IA de décision de Microsoft a des fondations chinoises. Présenté le 9 octobre, Microsoft-Decision-1 repose sur Qwen3.5-9B, un modèle de 9 milliards de paramètres développé par Alibaba, auquel les équipes de Redmond ont appliqué un entraînement spécialisé. L’outil est disponible préversion publique dans Microsoft Foundry et sur OpenRouter.
Ce qui étonne dans ce choix, c’est qu’OpenAI, le partenaire historique de Microsoft dans l’intelligence artificielle, propose déjà une API Decisions pour ces mêmes usages. Redmond a pourtant construit son propre modèle sur Qwen, tout en prévoyant des déclinaisons sur ses modèles MAI et ceux d’OpenAI.
À quoi sert une IA qui ne rédige rien ?
Prenons l’exemple d’une demande qui arrive à un service client. Faut-il l’envoyer à la facturation, à l’assistance technique ou au service commercial ? Le logiciel transmet le message et les options au modèle qui attribue une probabilité à chacune. L’application peut alors aiguiller la demande ou solliciter un humain si le résultat est trop incertain.

articles.title: Open-source project moves one step closer to letting you run PlayStation 5 games natively on PC
articles.summary:
What we know so far: The open-source AnyPS5 project has taken a major step toward its goal of letting gamers run PlayStation 5 games natively on Windows and Linux PCs. Hosted on GitHub, the project now reports 100% GPU shader instruction coverage, with all 1,166 tracked AMD RDNA 1 and RDNA 2 instructions implemented, thanks to contributions from more than 100 (human) developers alongside AI-generated code.
AnyPS5 has successfully decoded the GPU instruction set used by the PS5's "Oberon" SoC, which pairs an 8-core AMD Zen 2 CPU with a custom RDNA 2 GPU. The developers note, however, that only instructions recognized by the decoder were counted, while decoded opcodes absent from AMD's public list were not.
It's also worth noting that the system libraries aren't fully translated yet, with the latest data showing 3,052 of 3,535 functions, or 86.34%, implemented. The developers clarified that the list only covers functions already declared in the project's core/libs/prx directory and doesn't account for every function exported by the PS5 firmware..
For those unfamiliar, AnyPS5 is a compatibility layer that lets PS5 binaries run natively on PC by converting executables built for the PlayStation 5 into formats Windows or Linux can read, much like Wine or Proton. It works by translating the PS5's proprietary API calls, such as those for graphics, audio, or user services, into native calls on Windows and Linux.

articles.title: Long-lost horror gaming cult classic P.T. gets a much-needed PC port
articles.summary:
For over a decade now, the only “official” way to play Hideo Kojima’s cult classic, P.T.—the long-discontinued “playable trailer” for Kojima’s canceled “Silent Hills” project—has been via one of the increasingly rare PlayStation 4s that previously downloaded a copy during its monthslong availability window. Now, though, one coder is helping to preserve the game with a porting tool that builds a playable x86 PC executable from the original PS4 files.
Coder Lorean Xavier said he was inspired to work on the “P.T. for PC” project “because P.T. deserved to keep existing somewhere other than on consoles that still have it installed.” The open source porting effort rebuilds the P.T. engine in C++ and Vulkan, using the original files from the PS4 game to re-create “every level, model, texture, sound, script and cutscene,” according to its GitHub listing. That means players without their own legitimate decrypted copy of the original P.T. will have to track one down in order to generate a playable PC version.
The reliance on real P.T. files makes this port more authentic than previous hobbyist efforts to re-create the look and feel of P.T. for a PC audience. And while PS4 emulators recently reached a point where they could run P.T. completely, this native port also sports extra features, like upscaling and frame-generation, a camera mode, experimental third-person and VR support, and a “museum” section where you can look at and listen to in-game assets (including “unused content”).

articles.title: When Should You Use Liquid Clustering? Benchmarking Lakehouse Layout Strategies

Key Takeaways
- No single storage layout is universally optimal for lakehouse analytics: The right choice is workload-dependent, because using Liquid Clustering, ZOrder, or Partitioning incorrectly can materially impact cost and latency.
- ZOrder has a hidden failure mode. When a date column appears as a secondary or tertiary clustering key, time range queries perform significantly worse than on a simple date-partitioned table.
- Bytes scanned is a misleading performance proxy. Liquid Clustering delivers the lowest latency on point lookups despite scanning more raw data than ZOrder.
- Liquid Clustering should be the default for any team whose query patterns are diverse or evolving and outperforms ZOrder on most workloads while eliminating the operational burden of manual OPTIMIZE jobs and periodic full table rewrites.
- Before finalizing any layout strategy, ask yourself: ”Do my top queries consistently filter on the same two or three columns? If the answer is yes, ZOrder those columns. Otherwise, choose Liquid Clustering.

No single storage layout is universally optimal for lakehouse analytical systems. Across four workload types benchmarked on Delta Lake, Liquid Clustering delivers the lowest latency for point lookups, time-range aggregations, and large aggregations. A estratégia do Nubank com o novo programa de pontos
Vice-presidente Arthur Valadão concede entrevista exclusiva ao Tecnoblog.
O Nubank quer usar o recém-lançado programa de pontos NuCoin para “reconhecer” quem já usa a empresa como banco principal – e não necessariamente quem gasta mais no cartão. Em entrevista exclusiva ao Tecnoblog, o vice-presidente Arthur Valadão me disse que todos os produtos do banco estarão ligados ao programa, inclusive o serviço de telefonia NuCel, que deve ganhar um novo produto “em breve”.
Valadão define o NuCoin como um programa “focado em quem engaja e traz a principalidade para o Nubank”. A “principalidade”, no jargão do mercado financeiro, é a condição de banco principal do cliente, aquele que se concentra a movimentação do dia a dia. Ainda de acordo com o executivo, é preciso reconhecer os consumidores que estão com o Nubank há dez anos.

This Chennai startup is building a device to help doctors choose the right antibiotic sooner
Attox Research Laboratories is developing a testing device that shows which antibiotic will work on a patient's infection, and at what dose.
When a patient arrives with a bacterial infection, doctors may have to choose an antibiotic before laboratory tests confirm which one will work. A sensitivity test checks which antibiotic can kill the bacteria in a patient’s sample, but standard testing takes 24 to 48 hours. The first prescription, including the dose, therefore often relies on an assumption.
That has consequences beyond the first few days of treatment. Antibiotics taken when they are not needed, or in excess, contribute to antimicrobial resistance, making the drugs less effective against bacteria.
Chennai-based Attox Research Laboratories is developing a device to shorten that wait. Its flagship product, the Bactolizer, is designed to identify the effective antibiotic and the correct dose from a list of 15 antibiotics in about 30 minutes to two hours.
Attox was founded in 2023 by Clement, Suganth and Senthil. Clement holds an MBA and has more than 18 years of experience in startup building and organisational management. articles.title: Cloudflare’s OHTTP Gateway Refuses to Decrypt Requests That Arrive Through Cloudflare
articles.summary:
Cloudflare has opened a closed beta of the Cloudflare OHTTP Gateway, a managed endpoint that decrypts Oblivious HTTP requests on an origin’s behalf. The design decision that drew most of the attention is a refusal rather than a feature: the Gateway will not decrypt requests that reach it from Cloudflare Workers or from hosts proxied through Cloudflare.
Oblivious HTTP, standardized as RFC 9458, splits a request across two parties. The client encrypts the inner HTTP request to the gateway’s public key using HPKE and sends the sealed payload to a relay. The relay sees the client’s IP address but cannot read the request. The gateway decrypts it and forwards plain HTTP to the application, so it sees the contents but only ever sees the relay’s address.
That only works if different operators run the two hops. Putting a Worker in front of the Gateway, or proxying the relay through Cloudflare, would route the client-identifying hop and the decryption hop through the same company, so Cloudflare built a product that declines to run in that configuration. Authors Lara Schull and Akshat Mahajan write that the model "requires that the relay and app server be operated by separate, non-colluding parties."
For a team evaluating this, the practical cost is the relay. Cloudflare does not supply one for the Gateway, and says the component is not the hard part, since relays "can run on any infrastructure provider, and they’re simple." The hard part is being in a position to "verifiably promise to…

articles.title: Intel to phase out SGX after Xeon Diamond Rapids in favor of TDX — confidential computing pivot adds trusted I/O and post-quantum crypto for agentic AI
articles.summary:
Intel to phase out SGX after Xeon Diamond Rapids in favor of TDX — confidential computing pivot adds trusted I/O and post-quantum crypto for agentic AI
Diamond Rapids last to support SGX.
Just five years after bringing its Software Guard Extensions (SGX) technology to its mainstream server platform, Intel on Friday announced plans to discontinue its support after its upcoming Xeon 'Diamond Rapids' CPUs and concentrate its confidential computing efforts on Trust Domain Extensions (TDX). The company will continue to support existing SGX-enabled platforms into the early 2030s, but at the same time will expand TDX capabilities to address emerging requirements of cloud computing, enterprise workloads, and agentic AI applications.
Without a doubt, data sovereignty requirements are an increasingly important factor as organizations seek to protect sensitive information from unauthorized access even when they process it on infrastructure operated by third parties. Although both Intel SGX and TDX are designed to protect sensitive information while it is being processed, they use substantially different approaches.
SGX provides hardware-protected enclaves within applications to isolate selected code and data from other software, including the operating system and hypervisor. By contrast, TDX isolates entire virtual machines from the underlying host environment, including the hypervisor and other VMs. While SGX requires developers to design or modify applications to use protected enclave…

articles.title: This AI startup says it can generate permit-ready blueprints in minutes | TechCrunch
articles.summary:
Nearly two decades ago, a young college student wrote his final thesis about software capable of generating design documents for school buildings. Al Dram was studying architecture — following in the footsteps of his parents and grandfather — but it was technology that really intrigued him.
There was just one problem: The technology his idea required didn’t exist yet.
“Then ChatGPT came along,” said Dram, recalling when OpenAI released the generative AI chatbot that uses large language models (LLMs) in November 2022.
His old idea suddenly seemed a lot more possible. Within six months, he launched the concept of Blueprints AI, a startup that uses AI to produce code-compliant and permit-ready architectural construction blueprints in minutes from a 2D sketch or PDF.
Blueprints AI, which Dram officially incorporated in 2025 in Santa Monica with co-founder Coco Cao, was selected for the 2026 Startup Battlefield 200, a cohort of promising early-stage startups that have earned a spot to exhibit at this year’s TechCrunch Disrupt, taking place this week from October 13 to 15 in San Francisco.
During that 20-year lead-up to Blueprints AI, Dram earned his bachelor’s and master’s degrees in architecture from the University of Tehran and completed two years of PhD coursework on digital design at the European Graduate School in Switzerland. articles.title: WHO report on Russian lab worker death highlights "key uncertainty"
articles.summary:
Over the weekend, the World Health Organization released a disease outbreak report on the events surrounding the death of a Russian infectious disease researcher earlier this month, highlighting that Russia has yet to report a confirmed cause of death. With that “key uncertainty,” the United Nations health agency said it remains impossible to assess the risk of the event or whether the public health measures Russia took were adequate to prevent spread of the unknown disease.
The WHO reported that, so far, it has seen no evidence of ongoing transmission of the mystery disease. “However, confidence in the assessment remains limited by the absence of a confirmed etiological diagnosis, and the remaining uncertainty regarding the source and mode of exposure,” the agency wrote in its report.
The agency laid out the order of events as information trickled out from Russian authorities, noting that it only became aware of the death via media reports on October 2. The WHO subsequently made contact with Russian authorities and requested information on October 3, 6, 7, and 8.
Limited information released
Early media reports indicated that the lab worker had become ill on September 29, possibly following an incident at the lab, the Irkutsk Antiplague Research Institute (APRI) of Siberia and the Far East. Some early reports suggested that the researcher—who was identified by media as 28-year-old Darya Shipilova—died of the plague after breaking a test tube.

articles.title: ‘None of the features I liked from Fitbit’s app are left’: Google is forcing the last Fitbit fans onto Google Health, but people are calling it the ‘end of an era’
articles.summary:
‘I hate the new Google Health app’: Fitbit fans bemoan the ‘end of an era’ as last holdouts are forced to switch to Google’s alternative
The final goodbye for the Fitbit app
- Fitbit users are being forced to switch to the Google Health app
- The changeover process started months ago
- The switch has not been mandatory until now, and users aren’t happy
It’s been a few months since Google started encouraging Fitbit users to switch over to the company’s Google Health app, but the move has never been completely mandatory. That’s all changed now, though, as Fitbit fans are finding themselves forced onto Google’s platform — and many are deeply unhappy about the move.
As documented by users on social media, opening the Fitbit app now serves up a new prompt that reads: 'A newer Fitbit app is available. Updating is recommended.' The word “recommended” is doing a lot of heavy lifting there, as the only button available is one that says 'Update', and it’s impossible to tap away from the notification to make it disappear. In other words, this is a forced update for the last die-hards who are still using the deprecated Fitbit app.

articles.title: Dónde está la papelera de WhatsApp y cómo borrar archivos duplicados
articles.summary:
La papelera de WhatsApp no existe como una carpeta convencional, pero la aplicación cuenta con una función para localizar y eliminar fotos, videos, documentos y archivos duplicados. La herramienta se llama Administrar almacenamiento y permite liberar memoria sin revisar cada conversación de forma individual.
La acumulación de contenido en chats, grupos y canales puede ocupar una parte importante del espacio disponible en el teléfono. Cuando la memoria comienza a agotarse, WhatsApp puede mostrar alertas, impedir la descarga de nuevos archivos o dificultar el envío de mensajes. Por ese motivo, la gestión del almacenamiento se ha convertido en una opción útil para identificar qué contenido ocupa más espacio y decidir qué debe desaparecer.
Dónde está la “papelera” de WhatsApp
La expresión “papelera secreta de WhatsApp” suele utilizarse para referirse a un apartado que no funciona como una papelera tradicional. Los archivos no quedan allí de forma temporal antes de borrarse. En realidad, Administrar almacenamiento reúne el material multimedia guardado por la aplicación y lo ordena según su tamaño, antigüedad o frecuencia de reenvío.
Desde ese menú es posible comprobar cuánto espacio utiliza WhatsApp en el dispositivo. También muestra los chats, grupos, canales y categorías que concentran más archivos. De esta forma, el usuario puede detectar conversaciones con muchos videos, documentos pesados, fotografías repetidas o notas de voz que ya no necesita conservar.

articles.title: Pablo Cerezo, sociólogo: "Si lo analizas, lo más normal es tatuarse. La anomalía histórica y antropológica es no hacerlo"
articles.summary:
En el gimnasio, en la playa, en la piscina de la comunidad de vecinos, en el parque o el centro comercial. Seguro que hasta en tu oficina. No importa dónde estés, si observas con atención y el tiempo suficiente es (muy) difícil que no te encuentres con alguien tatuado. Quizás lleve una discreta rosa en el antebrazo, como Ayuso, o un diseño que le cubre el cuello a lo Sergio Ramos. No importa.
En general y según un estudio de Lutronic PBS, el 42% de los españoles lucen al menos un tatto, lo que nos convierte en el sexto país más marcado por la tinta.
Una cosa sin embargo es saber cuánto nos tatuamos y otra muy distinta entender por qué lo hacemos. ¿Qué queremos decir al cubrirnos la piel con una tinta indeleble? ¿Es puro narcisismo, una forma de definir nuestra identidad o establecer vínculos con otras personas (familia, amigos, seguidores de un mismo club de fútbol o una saga cinematográfica…)?
¿Lo hacemos por imitación en rebaño, por aquello de 'la gente va donde va Vicente', como sostiene algún columnista?
El mundo a través de los tatus
Todas esas cuestiones (y algunas más) las aborda Pablo Cerezo (Sevilla, 1998) en un ensayo de título sugerente: 'El cuerpo enunciado'. Su punto de partida es tan simple como ambicioso. Cerezo, graduado en Relaciones Internacionales y Sociología y librero en la emblemática librería Pérgamo de Madrid, cree que el tatuaje puede ayudarnos a "explicar nuestro tiempo".

Jetzt schreiben, später versenden: Whatsapp arbeitet an praktischer Planungsfunktion für Nachrichten
Whatsapp hat eine neue Funktion entwickelt, mit der Nutzer:innen ihre Nachrichten planen können. Wie WABetainfo berichtet, ist diese mit dem Beta-Update 2.26.40.7 jetzt im Googles Play-Store für Android-Geräte verfügbar. Mithilfe der neuen Funktion können Nutzer:innen eine Nachricht verfassen und festlegen, zu welchem Zeitpunkt sie verschickt werden soll.
So funktioniert das neue Planungsfeature
Whatsapp ist der beliebteste Messenger der Deutschen. Fast neun von zehn der über 16-Jährigen nutzt die App laut einer Analyse von Meltwater und We Are Social mindestens einmal im Monat. Die neue Funktion ermöglicht es Nutzer:innen, eine Nachricht über die Chat-Oberfläche zu planen. Nachdem sie einen Text eingegeben haben, muss die Schaltfläche zum Versenden gedrückt und gehalten werden. Ist die Funktion verfügbar, erscheint ein Fenster, in dem sich der Versand zeitlich festlegen lässt. Anschließend wird die Nachricht durch Whatsapp automatisch zum gewählten Zeitpunkt versendet – auch wenn die App geschlossen ist.
Derzeit unterstützt die Nachrichtenplanung laut WABetainfo Text, Links, Fotos und Videos. articles.summary:
Après des écouteurs, un casque, et des clips d’oreille, CMF vient de dévoiler les deux premières enceintes waterproof de l’univers Nothing/CMF, les Speaker S et Speaker M. L'ex marque fille du spécialiste de la transparence suit la même logique qu’habituellement : design très original et tarif abordable.
Au programme, des enceintes nomades et baroudeuses (IP68) au design mimant des briques de lait ou de jus de fruits, des couleurs assumées, et surtout une approche technologique sans concession, avec LE Audio/Auracast et USB-Audio, le tout saupoudré de l’application Nothing X.
Du lait ? Du jus de fruits ? Non, du son
Impossible de passer à côté, CMF assume voire revendique le design en brique de lait de ses deux créations. Ici seules les dimensions diffèrent vraiment. La Speaker S est particulièrement compacte et légère (130,5 x 85 x 44 mm pour 334 g), proche d’un cube, tandis que la Speaker M est déjà nettement plus allongée et plus lourde (220 x 85 x 54 mm pour 602 g). Si la conception est intégralement en plastique, quoiqu’un plastique de bonne qualité, nous avons heureusement droit à une certification IP68, le maximum disponible pour un produit de ce type. articles.title: Microsoft president says UK is best placed to drive AI regulation | TechCrunch
articles.summary:
Microsoft president Brad Smith is calling for urgent regulation of AI, and his argument is that consumer products like milk and washing machines have more oversight than the companies building artificial intelligence.
On a recent BBC podcast, Smith called AI both a “weapon and a tool” that is putting the world’s cybersecurity at risk and said the “moment has arrived” to institute global safety rules.
Smith also said the U.K., and not the U.S. or European Union, is best placed to lead on global safety rules. Britain’s AI Security Institute (AISI), launched in 2023, receives access to major models from U.S. frontier labs before they are deployed and has quickly become a leader in AI safety testing.
That role has been under threat in recent weeks, with U.S. president Donald Trump warning against “globalist” organizations, which he claims are interfering with American companies. Last month, he reportedly asked Anthropic and OpenAI to withhold new models from British testers, but AISI confirmed on Monday that it is able to access and test the latest models.
Despite the president’s pushback, however, Smith argued the U.K. can regulate AI in ways that the U.S. cannot.
“In Washington, D.C., people don’t look at the U.K. and they don’t look at London the way they look at Brussels,” he told the BBC. “That’s a strength.”
His comments come amid rallying cries from tech leaders, including Anthropic’s Dario Amodei and OpenAI’s Sam Altman, to slow the pace of AI development in the wake of s…

articles.title: After a 10-year redemption arc, No Man's Sky is coming to the iPhone and iPad
articles.summary:
Just over 10 years after its initial release, space exploration and survival crafting game No Man’s Sky is making its way to the iPhone and iPad, Apple and developer Hello Games announced today.
It will run on devices as far back as the iPhone 11 and the third-generation iPad Air. No Man’s Sky might not have the most cutting-edge AAA graphics (though they’re still strong, and they’ve come a long way since launch via updates), but the game’s uncommon method of generating galaxies of incomprehensible scale on device consistently for all players from a single-seed happening on a phone is remarkable for those of us who remember phones performing far behind consoles or desktop PCs.
This version of the game includes all of the content and systems updates to the game that have been added over the years—the expansions that famously took the game from a rocky launch reception to a widely beloved redemption story.
There are a couple of compromises, though, and it’s similar to what we saw with No Man’s Sky on the Nintendo Switch. Hello Games says the ability to build and explore player-made planetary settlements is limited to the iPhone 15 Pro and later, and multiplayer is not supported on any iOS device. “We are excited to see player feedback on iOS, and will support it appropriately based on how many folks are playing,” the company says, leaving the door open to perhaps not supporting all future content updates if the player base isn’t there to justify it.

articles.title: Kubo Care uses radar technology to keep senior citizens safe at home
articles.summary:
Kubo Care uses radar technology to keep elders safe at home
Bengaluru-based startup Kubo Care uses millimetre-wave radar devices to monitor seniors and detect falls without intrusive cameras or wearables.
As families increasingly live in different cities and countries, keeping ageing parents safe at home can be a challenge. Full-time attendants require trust and may not always be reliable, while video cameras can feel intrusive, particularly in bathrooms, where more than half of serious falls occur. Wearable devices such as smartwatches and panic pendants offer another option, but seniors may forget to wear or charge them.
Bengaluru-based Kubo Care is addressing this problem with a system that monitors movement continuously without recording video or audio, while keeping families informed.
The healthtech startup was founded in 2024 by CEO Ayush Agrawal and COO Anurag Ram Chandran. Agrawal, who previously co-founded senior care ecommerce platform Seniority and worked as an AVP at CARS24, experienced the problem firsthand when his father suffered a stroke and fell while alone at home. He remained undiscovered for hours.
Chandran, a Schwarzman Scholar who previously ran an Indian NGO, became the primary caregiver for his grandmother after she was diagnosed with Alzheimer’s disease. His experience exposed him to gaps in elderly care.

articles.title: Heizen statt kühlen: Hacker übernehmen smarte Kühlschränke in europäischen Supermärkten
articles.summary:
Heizen statt kühlen: Hacker übernehmen smarte Kühlschränke in europäischen Supermärkten
Während smarte Kühlschränke im privaten Bereich wohl noch eher selten vorzufinden sind, setzen immer mehr Supermärkte und Discounter auf die Hilfe der cleveren Geräte. Dadurch lassen sich digitale Preisschilder und auch die Temperatur zentralisiert aus der Ferne regeln. Wie die meisten Gadgets, die mit dem Internet verbunden sind, besteht aber auch bei smarten Kühlschränken das Risiko eines Cyberangriffs. Und genau das findet gerade in Frankreich und den Niederlanden statt.
Hackerangriff: Smarte Kühlschränke werden zu Heizungen
Wie Tom’s Hardware berichtet, haben sich Hacker:innen Zugriff auf smarte Kühlschränke des Herstellers Danfoss verschafft. Die Geräte werden unter anderem von den französischen Supermärkten Intermarché, Leclerc und Coopérative U genutzt. Die Hacker:innen starten bei den betroffenen Kühlschränken die Defrostfunktion. Dadurch heizen die Geräte auf 50 Grad Celsius auf, statt zu kühlen.
Da die Funktion eigentlich nur für leere Kühlschränke gedacht ist, werden die enthaltenen Lebensmittel dabei ungenießbar. Agentic e-commerce startup Loops Smart AI wants to help online retailers create more seamless buying journeys and streamline the shopping experience after raising $3.5 million in seed funding today.

All it leads to, he says, is fragmentation and disconnected experiences.
For instance, a retailer might add one AI tool to help with product searches, and a separate chatbot for answering customer’s questions, then another for generating product descriptions, followed by another to enable virtual try-ons. Nazir said these AI tools are all useful on their own, but the problem is they’re running in siloes, so they only understand a small piece of the overall customer journey. Venture capitalists like Chamath Palihapitiya have suggested that intellectual property, the underlying proprietary ownership of written software code, is effectively dead, he added.

That’s according to a Bloomberg report, which cites unnamed people familiar with the project who commented on the significant pivot in internal development at the Unreal Engine maker.
Human developers will be tasked with managing and guiding code and art assets generated by models such as Anthropic’s Claude, according to internal Epic employee messages viewed by Bloomberg. That means “no more hand-written code” and art assets “generated with full AI workflows,” according to the report.
The $1.5 billion collaboration between Epic and Disney, announced in early 2024, was slated to release a Marvel- and Star Wars-themed shooter in March 2027. That project has now been delayed indefinitely amid the AI-related shakeup and understaffed, slower-than-expected development thus far, according to the report.
“We’re embracing AI-accelerated development, led by Epic developers who are the visionaries and creative drivers for everything we do,” an Epic spokesperson said in a statement.

articles.title: 39-year-old unvaccinated woman becomes 6th measles death in Pennsylvania
articles.summary:
A 39-year-old unvaccinated woman in Franklin County, Pennsylvania, has become the sixth person to die of the highly infectious virus amid a state outbreak that has stricken over a thousand people since it began in April.
The woman died on Saturday, October 10. She had several underlying health conditions and had recently tested positive for measles, according to an advisory posted on social media by Franklin County Coroner Jordan Conner. The advisory noted that the woman’s death meets the definition of a measles death set by the state’s health department.
In an emailed statement to The Washington Post, the coroner’s office said the primary cause of death was listed as “probable acute cardiac event due to possible complications of the measles.”
The previous five deaths amid the state’s measles outbreak included a newborn, a 6-week-old, an 18-year-old, a 20-year-old, and a 40-year-old. All the deceased were unvaccinated; the two infants were too young to have been vaccinated.
As of the latest measles update from Pennsylvania’s health department on Friday, October 9, there have been 1,136 cases in the state since the start of the year—1,124 of which are from the current outbreak. Overall, 218 people have been hospitalized. The outbreak, which now spans 41 of the state’s 67 counties, shows no signs of slowing. There had been 157 new cases reported just in the previous week.

Diese privaten Schlüssel dienen der Wiederherstellung des Zugangs zur Wallet – und öffnen Angreifer:innen das Tor zu den darauf verwahrten Kryptowährungen.

Jev-like decision models are flooding the AI market, after researcher claims TypeSafe copied their research — Microsoft, OpenAI among companies releasing lightweight 'System One' AI models
Round and round the AI world goes.
Following the release of TypeSafe's Jev, many AI players have launched competitors, and many similar open-source projects from the likes of Microsoft, OpenAI, and many more have since emerged. Yet Nandakishor Mukkunnoth, of ConvAI Innovations, said that he'd come up with the base notions for Jev's architecture over a year before. So who copied who?
As a quick recap, Jev and its clones are APIs driven by decision models, for use in your own code. You feed them input data like a customer's online shopping transactions, alongside questions. For example: "is the user looking for a return?" for a yes/no answer, and "Which item are they referring to?" with a multiple-choice answer. A Jev-like AI model will answer each of the questions or choices with a probability that can then be used in your own "if" statements. While the concept by itself isn't strictly new, this practical application is indeed novel.
The release made a good portion of the internet abuzz, as the seemingly simple concept is extremely useful and neatly sidesteps the usual problems with trying to coax an LLM into giving a direct answer. articles.title: Creíamos que el plomo llegó a la península Ibérica con los fenicios, pero una aldea de Lleida ya lo fundía casi mil años antes
articles.summary:
Desde que la humanidad aprendió a sacar metales de las piedras, casi siempre la historia de la metalurgia ha ido de la mano del cobre y del bronce. Pues bien, hoy sabemos que sus orígenes fueron más dispares de lo que pensábamos. Es el caso del plomo, uno de los grandes olvidados. En la península Ibérica, la versión clásica lo asociaba a los fenicios, que llegaron hacia el año 1000 a.C., como recuerda la Universidad de Granada. Y bueno, sí y no: en un poblado de Lleida han aparecido trozos de plomo producidos allí mucho, mucho antes.
El hallazgo. Aparecieron en Minferri, un poblado de la Edad del Bronce en Juneda (Lleida), y eran tres fragmentos de escoria de entre 10 y 24 gramos que constituyen la prueba directa más antigua de fundición de plomo en Iberia. Para datarlos, el equipo de investigación analizó una semilla de trigo carbonizada hallada en el mismo silo que uno de los fragmentos, y su radiocarbono la sitúa entre el 1885 y el 1692 a. C.
Los otros dos fragmentos proceden de un pozo del mismo yacimiento, ocupado entre el 2100 y el 1600 a. C. aproximadamente. La producción se situaría, por tanto, hacia el 1900-1700 a. C., unos 700 a 900 años antes de la llegada de los fenicios.
Por qué importa. Porque cambia el quién y el cuándo. Hasta ahora se creía que el plomo ibérico llegó con los fenicios, que lo obtenían como subproducto de la plata. El estudio, liderado por la Universidad de Granada con Cambridge, la Universidad de Lleida e Iltirta Arqueología, describe en cambio…

Alpine devance la foule au Mondial en sortant un manifeste surprise de son avenir. L’A310 Vision s’exposera ainsi aux côtés de la sculpture annonçant la future A110 électrique. Paradoxe : la première, autrement plus concrète, n’accouchera pour le moment pas d’un modèle de série contrairement à la seconde… Est-ce une raison d’être déçu ? Vu le coup de crayon, les planètes semblent alignées pour espérer un futur radieux.
Car l’engin n’est pas une bête de foire venue de nulle part. Il puise ouvertement son inspiration de l’illustre A310 lancée en 1971. Et avec une belle fidélité : sa face avant plongeante avec ses feux finement taillés dans la carrosserie respectent ceux du modèle originel. La partie inférieure foncée fait à nouveau appel à une jupe aérodynamique encore plus exacerbée. Exacerbé également est le capot, doté d’un imposant extracteur d’air.
Un clin d’œil magistral au modèle originel de 1971
De profil, ce sont encore les jupes XXL qui frappent en soutenant des flancs amincis. Les jantes semi-pleines au motif triangulaire ont aussi leur mot à dire en étant ouvertement tirées de celles équipant la première A310. Ces roues prennent d’ailleurs place dans des passages de roues gonflés renforçant l’assise de l’engin. La poupe se veut en revanche un peu plus différenciante de l’ancêtre.

Our favorite new drones: these are the models that soared through our tests — and they're not all from DJI

It might not come as a surprise that DJI is particularly well represented — every 5-star drone of the past 20 or so months is a DJI model. The DJI Mini 5 Pro is a compact drone that's beginner-friendly yet boasts features more in line with far pricier models (including "class-leading video quality"). We also loved the DJI Avata 360, calling it "wonderfully versatile and surprisingly affordable", and dubbing it "the 360 drone to beat". Professional users, meanwhile, will struggle to find fault with the stunning DJI Mavic 4 Pro.

articles.title: Exclusive: Akuity adds Fleet Management to Kargo Enterprise to replace per-cluster pipelines - SiliconANGLE
articles.summary:
Exclusive: Akuity adds Fleet Management to Kargo Enterprise to replace per-cluster pipelines
Software delivery platform company Akuity Inc. today added Fleet Management to its Kargo Enterprise platform to allow teams to ship one change across hundreds of Kubernetes clusters as a single release.
Akuity is pitching it as a replacement for the per-cluster pipelines those teams maintain now. The new capability goes after a delivery problem that gets worse each time a company adds infrastructure.
Production environments that once meant one cluster or 10 now often run to hundreds, according to Akuity, with artificial intelligence speeding up that growth. Every new cluster adds release risk and slows delivery, the company said.
Kargo Enterprise, which runs on the Akuity Platform, is the commercial edition of Kargo, the open-source promotion project Akuity created. With Fleet Management switched on, teams group their clusters into a fleet and set the rollout order and failure threshold one time.
Kargo then promotes each change through the fleet wave by wave. Every cluster reports its own health along the way, and platform teams watching the rollout can tell how far a release has gotten at any point.
A rollout halts only after the failure rate passes the threshold a team picked at the start, which Akuity said keeps one failed cluster from stopping the whole fleet. Changes reach a pilot group first and canary clusters next before going to the general population. A health check sits bet…

articles.title: Un ciberataque pone patas arriba los frigoríficos de supermercados franceses y otro incidente afecta a cadenas europeas
articles.summary:
Cuando pensamos en ciberseguridad, es fácil imaginar un correo sospechoso, una contraseña robada o una página web que deja de funcionar. Pero los sistemas informáticos también intervienen en actividades que no asociamos de inmediato con una pantalla, como conservar alimentos a la temperatura adecuada. En un supermercado, parte de esa tarea depende de dispositivos electrónicos que supervisan y gestionan los equipos de refrigeración. Nos hemos acostumbrado tanto a que funcionen que rara vez reparamos en ellos. Hasta que la posibilidad de manipularlos nos obliga a mirar de otra manera algo tan cotidiano como abrir un frigorífico.
Un ataque contra la refrigeración. Eso es lo que han sufrido numerosos supermercados franceses durante la noche del domingo 11 al lunes 12 de octubre. Según la información publicada por AFP y Reuters, los atacantes lograron intervenir de forma remota en los sistemas encargados de regular la temperatura de los equipos frigoríficos y alterar su funcionamiento. articles.title: El Omoda 5 ya es uno de los híbridos más vendidos de nuestro país así que han tomado una decisión radical: mejorarlo
articles.summary:
Mayo de 2024.
Omoda nos ha convocado para conocer el Omoda 5.
Salimos desde la zona norte de Madrid para conducir durante decenas de kilómetros el primer coche de la compañía en nuestro país. Unas horas después, dejo el coche en un estado de cierta sorpresa. Estamos ante la opción de gasolina, sin modelo híbrido y siento que aunque tiene algunas cosas que pulir, este coche va a dar mucho que hablar.
Unos meses después, Francesco Colonnese ( vicepresidente de Omoda&Jaecoo Iberia) asegura que es la capacidad de adaptación y los ajustados tiempos de desarrollo lo que les da una ventaja diferencial frente a los europeos. Confirma con estas palabras algo que se rumoreaba extraoficialmente en aquella presentación del Omoda 5: ese mismo coche había estado rodando por España y en semanas habían cambiado muchos de los fallos que tenía antes de la presentación.
Tanto es así que el Omoda 5 que probamos aquel día en la primavera de hace dos años era sustancialmente diferente y mejor que el que aterrizó en un primer momento.
El tiempo ha dejado claro dos cosas.
La primera es que el Omoda 5 era un producto muy atractivo para España y que con la versión híbrida ganó los suficientes enteros para colarse entre los 10 coches híbridos (no enchufables) más vendidos de nuestro país. Una posición de gala en el segmento, pro tecnologías, más competido de nuestro mercado.

articles.title: Angriffe abwehren reicht nicht: Wer kontrolliert eigentlich deine E-Mails?
articles.summary:
Warum Unternehmen ihre E-Mail-Kommunikation zurückerobern müssen
Unternehmen versenden täglich Millionen von Bestellungen, Rechnungen, Verträge, Lieferinformationen oder sicherheitsrelevante Benachrichtigungen per E-Mail. Entsprechend hoch sind die Anforderungen an ihre Absicherung. Lange Zeit lag der Fokus dabei vor allem auf dem Schutz vor Spam, Malware und Phishing. Doch die Anforderungen haben sich verändert. Angesichts zunehmender geopolitischer Unsicherheit und immer strengerer regulatorischer Vorgaben wie DORA und NIS-2 steigen unter anderem die Anforderungen an Resilienz, Nachvollziehbarkeit und Audits. Digitale Souveränität ist damit zur Grundvoraussetzung für den Geschäftserfolg geworden.
Wer kontrolliert eigentlich die eigene E-Mail-Kommunikation?
Ein reibungslos funktionierender E-Mail-Betrieb bedeutet nicht automatisch digitale Souveränität. Erst die Transparenz über Prozesse, Datenflüsse und Zugriffswege gibt Unternehmen die volle Kontrolle über ihre geschäftskritische Kommunikation. Daher sollte eine E-Mail-Security-Lösung auf weit mehr als klassischen Schutzmechanismen basieren:
Datenhoheit statt bloßer Datenspeicherung
Der Speicherort von Daten allein entscheidet nicht über ihre Souveränität. Maßgeblich ist vielmehr, welchem Rechtsraum ein Anbieter unterliegt und welche gesetzlichen Zugriffsrechte gelten. Mit Retarus Email Security erhalten Unternehmen maximale Transparenz über Datenverarbeitung, Datenzugriffe und rechtliche Zuständigkeiten.

articles.title: Intel's Crescent Island AI accelerator officially powers new GPU D-Series products — chip delivers 1.3 peak PFLOPS of FP8 compute and 1.5 TB/s of memory bandwidth
articles.summary:
Intel's Crescent Island AI accelerator officially powers new GPU D-Series products — chip delivers 1.3 peak PFLOPS of FP8 compute and 1.5 TB/s of memory bandwidth
Crescent Island gets official performance and bandwidth specs at OCP 2026.
At OCP 2026 today, Intel has given Crescent Island a proper name: the Intel GPU D-Series. For the first time, the company also shared a theoretical peak performance target for the chip: 1.3 PFLOPS of FP8. It also disclosed the final memory bandwidth to expect from these AI inference accelerators: 1.5 TB/s. This new information adds to the slow drip of disclosures Intel has made about Crescent Island throughout 2026.
We already knew that Crescent Island is the first chip to be built on Intel's Xe3P graphics architecture (or massively parallel computing architecture, really, as the chip lacks most or all of the graphics-specific functional units that would characterize a true GPU). Intel will release GPU D-Series products in an air-cooled PCIe form factor with a TDP of 350W and up to 480GB of LPDDR5X memory.
For reference, each of the 72 Rubin GPUs in Nvidia's Vera Rubin NVL72 rack-scale system can push a theoretical 17.5 PFLOPS of FP8 throughput, but each of those chips requires liquid cooling and likely has a TGP measured in kilowatts. In any event, it should be clear that the GPU D-Series is targeting an entirely different performance envelope and infrastructure requirements than Rubin.

articles.title: NVIDIA RTX 5080 24 GB Reportedly Planned For Q1 2027, but Board Partners Are Still in the Dark
articles.summary:
Monday, October 12th 2026
NVIDIA RTX 5080 24 GB Reportedly Planned For Q1 2027, but Board Partners Are Still in the Dark
Taiwanese outlet BenchLife has added more detail to last week's report that NVIDIA is pulling GB202 silicon away from the GeForce RTX 5090. According to BenchLife, board partners are no longer receiving GB202 chips for RTX 5090 production. The same applies to the China-specific RTX 5090 D and RTX 5090 D V2 variants. NVIDIA hasn't said anything officially yet. Apparently, the company doesn't see this as an end-of-life (EOL) move either, since the chips are simply being shifted to more profitable GB202-based RTX PRO cards like the RTX PRO 6000 and the recently unveiled RTX PRO 5500. In the meantime, any RTX 5090 cards still reaching shelves are built from chips partners already have. The card immediately sold out at Walmart for $4,299 last month, so buyers shouldn't expect prices to come down anytime soon.
The RTX 5080 part of the story is a bit more interesting. BenchLife says NVIDIA plans to launch an RTX 5080 with 24 GB of GDDR7 in the first quarter of 2027, replacing the current 16 GB model. However, board partners have yet to receive any development material for it. So far they've only been told verbally that it should arrive soon. That's odd, considering partners reportedly had RTX 50 SUPER silicon in hand back in July, before GDDR7 pricing put that launch on hold. Dell’s AI partner ecosystem adapts to Silicon Valley’s build-it-yourself buyers
Silicon Valley’s AI partner ecosystem is changing as enterprises push artificial intelligence projects out of pilots and into production. In the region where much of the AI stack is invented, infrastructure providers are learning that selling to builders takes a different playbook.
That shift is reshaping how Dell Technologies Inc. approaches its West Coast customers. Buyers in the region are among the most technically sophisticated anywhere and often prefer assembling their own stacks to buying packaged solutions, according to Sean O’Connor (pictured), regional manager of ENT West, large enterprise and acquisition, at Dell.
“Silicon Valley is interesting because everybody here wants to build versus buy,” he said. “They’re very, very sharp and they’re very, very savvy when it comes to technology.”
O’Connor spoke with theCUBE Research’s John Furrier at the Dell “AI Leadership Symposium,” during an exclusive broadcast on theCUBE, SiliconANGLE Media’s livestreaming studio. articles.title: Los neumáticos se tiran enteros cuando solo una parte está gastada. Unos investigadores españoles quieren cambiarlo con un diseño modular
articles.summary:
Cambiar los neumáticos forma parte del mantenimiento habitual de un coche, y rara vez nos detenemos a pensar en qué estamos retirando exactamente. Lo que suele obligarnos a hacerlo es el desgaste de la banda de rodadura, esa superficie de caucho que pisa la carretera, pero bajo ella hay una estructura mucho mayor que no necesariamente ha llegado al final de su vida útil. La carcasa puede recuperarse en determinados casos mediante el recauchutado. La cuestión es por qué seguimos utilizando cubiertas que, por lo general, sustituimos completas cuando solo una parte ha llegado a su límite de desgaste.
La Universidad Carlos III de Madrid (UC3M) está ensayando una respuesta a esa pregunta. Su proyecto ECOTIRE propone un neumático concebido desde el principio para que la pieza sometida al mayor desgaste sea desmontable y pueda sustituirse sin desechar también la carcasa. Según explica el equipo, esa parte intercambiable representa menos del 20% del peso total, por lo que conservar el resto permitiría aprovechar una proporción considerable de los materiales. La idea ya se ha convertido en un prototipo físico, aunque sus resultados todavía pertenecen al terreno experimental y no al de los productos disponibles para los conductores.

articles.title: Applied Materials Bets $5B on a New Model for Chip Innovation - EE Times
articles.summary:
Applied Materials CEO Gary Dickerson sees semiconductor innovation becoming a race in which speed matters as much as technological capability. Artificial intelligence is driving demand for faster transistors, higher-bandwidth memory, and more efficient connections between chips. Delivering those improvements requires advances across multiple manufacturing processes, often several generations before the resulting devices enter production.
Applied Materials bets $5 billion that bringing more of the industry’s R&D activities together will help it win that race.
On Oct. 12, the company officially opened its Equipment and Process Innovation and Commercialization (EPIC) Center in Silicon Valley. The facility is designed to bring Applied Materials’ engineers together with researchers and engineers from chipmakers, universities, and other equipment suppliers to develop future semiconductor technologies.
The investment represents more than an expansion of Applied Materials’ R&D infrastructure. It reflects a shift in the company’s relationship with the semiconductor industry, from supplying equipment for processes developed with customers toward participating earlier in decisions about the materials, architectures, and manufacturing methods that will define future chips.
“We’re working four generations ahead of time,” Dickerson told EE Times in an interview before the opening. “Whoever brings those innovations to market fastest is going to win.”

articles.title: LineageOS débarque enfin sur les Pixel 10 et Pixel 10 Pro
articles.summary:
On l'attendait, cette version a pris plus de temps que prévu. LineageOS est enfin disponible pour certains smartphones de la gamme Pixel 10, mais pas pour tout le monde.
Plus d’un an après le lancement du Pixel 10, la solution alternative LineageOS est désormais officiellement disponible pour les smartphones de cette gamme. Même le moins cher de la gamme, le Pixel 10a y a droit. Les fichiers d'installation ont été publiés le jour même de l'annonce officielle de LineageOS 24.
Pourquoi LineageOS a pris tant de retard ?
On l'a attendu pendant un moment cette version sur les Google Pixel. Mais le délai s'explique par des facteurs indépendants de l'équipe de développement. Les démarches ont été rendues plus complexes pour les ROMs personnalisées, Google ayant arrêté de fournir les arborescences d'appareils, ainsi que les fichiers binaires des pilotes. Le développement prend donc plus de temps.
Google a effectivement changé de politique avec Android 16, ce qui a freiné les travaux en cours sur la génération d'appareils dévoilés à partir de cette version d'Android. À cela sont venus s'ajouter les retards dans la mise à disposition des kernels destinés aux smartphones Pixel.

articles.title: Hacer que un celular viejo se convierta en un robot humanoide es posible: solo cuesta 400 dólares

Un teléfono Android viejo puede convertirse en el cerebro de un robot humanoide gracias a un proyecto desarrollado por investigadores de la Universidad de California en Los Ángeles (UCLA), Estados Unidos.
El prototipo, bautizado como PhoneBot, demuestra que un smartphone de gama baja o incluso un modelo lanzado en 2017 puede controlar los movimientos de un robot bípedo, procesar su visión y mantener su equilibrio, sin necesidad de hardware costoso adicional.
Cómo el teléfono se convierte en el cerebro del robot
PhoneBot es un robot que utiliza un smartphone Android para interpretar su entorno y controlar su propio movimiento, sin depender de componentes electrónicos especializados y costosos. El teléfono se instala en posición vertical dentro del torso y cumple la función de cabeza.
Desde ahí asume casi todas las tareas de procesamiento. Su cámara detecta personas y permite que el robot las siga. Su unidad de medición inercial, compuesta por giroscopio y acelerómetro, registra la orientación del cuerpo y ayuda a mantener el equilibrio.
El procesador del propio celular ejecuta el modelo que controla las articulaciones, mientras que la pantalla permite consultar el estado del sistema. Ninguno de estos componentes tiene una conexión física con el chasis: todas las órdenes viajan por wifi hasta un pequeño ordenador instalado en el cuerpo del robot, encargado de accionar los motores.

AI agents are great at writing new code — but then the human bottleneck slows everything down
AI is speeding up code production, but reviewing is the next bottleneck
- Lines of code, code commits and pull requests are all up 20-30%
- Comments per pull request are up 49% as human review becomes more crucial
- With reviewing up from 7 to 10 days on average, the new bottleneck is code review
A new Harvard University research paper has confirmed that AI is indeed excellent at boosting coding productivity, but humans just end up slowing the process back down anyway.
Authors Fiona Chen and James Stratton found a 30% increase in the amount of code developers can produce when using AI, but they found no statistically significant improvement in completed software.
With increases across lines of code produced (+30%), code commits (+20%) and pull requests (+23%), the Harvard-backed researchers went on to investigate why we're not seeing a 20-30% increase in end product.
AI has definitely sped up coding, but human delays negate much of those benefits
At the same time, the researchers also found increases across the time taken to review and merge pull requests (+49%), the number of reviewer comments per pull request (+35%) and even the proportion of employees doing code reviews (+14%), all of which implying that vibe coding is ultimately shifting the bottleneck further down the road instead of removing it altogether.

Orange précise qu’une absence de moins de quinze minutes ne coupe rien, la box se reconnectant automatiquement au retour. Le bilan publié le 9 octobre recense quatre familles de dérapages commis sur de vrais sites web, dont certains appartiennent à des administrations américaines. Une sanction accompagne le rapport : plus aucune évaluation interne n’aura accès à Internet tant que les outils de surveillance du laboratoire n’auront pas fait leurs preuves.
Un faux tuyau pour un vrai meurtre
Le 18 juillet vers 23 h 30, le formulaire de PhillyUnsolvedMurders.com, le site de la police de Philadelphie consacré aux meurtres non élucidés, reçoit ce message : « j’ai peut-être des informations sur cette affaire. Je me souviens avoir vu quelqu’un correspondant à la description dans le secteur à cette période. » L’auteur s’appelle Claude Haiku 4.5. Chargé de générer des interactions d’exemple sur des pages web tirées au hasard, le modèle est tombé sur l’affaire, a rempli le champ libre, laissé vides le nom et le contact, puis validé. La page ne contenait aucune description du suspect ; classé comme spam, le message n’a jamais atteint les enquêteurs.
La police n’a appris son existence que le 7 octobre, alors qu’Anthropic avait repéré l’incident fin septembre. Le département juge ce délai « inacceptable », tout en confirmant qu’aucun de ses systèmes n’a été compromis.

GlobalFoundries Returns to Advanced-Node Race With 7 nm-Class FDX Fusion
Back in the now distant 2018, the semiconductor industry had three major players in contract leading-edge node manufacturing: TSMC, Samsung, and GlobalFoundries. At that time, Intel did not accept external clients. However, as node design became increasingly expensive—requiring multi-billion dollar investments—and more complex, with many players encountering yield and manufacturing difficulties, GlobalFoundries announced that it was stopping its 7 nm node development indefinitely. This left only two companies in the leading-edge race, but GlobalFoundries continued to develop unique semiconductor solutions that did not focus on smaller transistor sizes.
Today, the company is back at a similar stopping point but with a unique solution called FDX Fusion, based on fully-depleted silicon-on-insulator (FD-SOI) technology. Unlike traditional CMOS, GlobalFoundries takes substrate isolation a step further by creating a fully insulating layer beneath the channel. This enables highly specialized capabilities, such as ultra-low-power in-memory computing, seamless integration of embedded non-volatile memory (like eMRAM), and highly efficient dense logic designs. articles.title: Nintendo Says Physical Switch 2 Games Are Here to Stay
articles.summary:
Monday, October 12th 2026
Nintendo Says Physical Switch 2 Games Are Here to Stay
Nintendo isn't following Sony toward a digital-only future, at least for now. Videocardz reports that Bill van Zyll, Nintendo's Vice President and General Manager for Latin America, said the company has no plans to drop physical games on the Switch 2. He spoke to Brazilian YouTube channel Coelho no Japão at Brasil Game Show (BGS) 2026, telling them that Nintendo goes by what customers prefer and that the Switch 2 supports both physical and digital releases. His exact words were: "There's no plans to ditch physical. We know how much the fans like it as well." Apparently, physical games are especially popular in Latin America, Brazil included. 
Nintendo's clarification is important, as Sony, on the other hand, confirmed in July that disc production for new PlayStation games will end in January 2028, although games released before then won't be affected. That decision drew plenty of backlash, and data from Alinea Analytics later showed discs still bring in a sizeable share of revenue for PlayStation's biggest exclusives. Nintendo's own numbers point toward digital dominance too, with 61.5% of its software sales coming from digital in the April to June quarter. The company has also been pricing digital Switch 2 exclusives lower than their physical versions since May. Of course, plans can change, though for the foreseeable future, cartridges seem safe on the Switch 2.

Ackerman obtuvo el permiso de Tolkien para crear una película de animación basada en 'El señor de los anillos'. El guion fue encargado a Morton Grady Zimmerman, y la ambición del proyecto era enorme: debía condensar todo el viaje de Frodo y la Compañía del Anillo en una película de tres horas de duración.
El enfado de Tolkien. Cuando el manuscrito llegó a manos del escritor, la respuesta fue fulminante. articles.title: Microsoft debuts multichiplet Maia 300 inference accelerator - SiliconANGLE
articles.summary:
Microsoft debuts multichiplet Maia 300 inference accelerator
Microsoft Corp. today pulled back the curtains on Maia 300, its newest internally developed artificial intelligence accelerator.
The chip is optimized for inference, the process of generating responses to AI queries. Microsoft estimates that it can process 40% more tokens per megawatt than “leading GPU-based systems,” which is likely a reference to Nvidia Corp. products. The company said the Maia chip series will become its primary source of inference capacity over time.
Maia 300 features four computing chiplets made using Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co.’s latest two-nanometer node. The chiplets are flanked by eight HBM4 modules with 288 gigabytes of combined capacity, the same amount as Nvidia Corp.’s flagship Rubin accelerator. However, Maia 300 has about 20% less memory bandwidth than Rubin. Memory bandwidth is a measure of how much fast data can be transferred to and from RAM.
AI chips usually perform inference by repeatedly shifting data between their computing and memory circuits. That constant movement slows down processing. According to Microsoft, Maia 300 features a dataflow architecture designed to minimize data movement. When possible, the computing chiplets keep information in an internal SRAM cache instead of sending it to the HBM stacks.
In situations where using HBM can’t be avoided, Maia 300’s computing chiplets send data to a memory stack that is physically nearby. That’s faster than transmit…

articles.title: Inventamos las piscifactorías para salvar a los peces, pero ha terminado en algo delirante: unos Juegos del Hambre que terminan en Canarias
articles.summary:
Una investigación llevada a cabo por un grupo de investigadores internacionales junto a de Outlaw Ocean Project ha llegado a una conclusión muy sencilla: el gran invento para frenar la sobrepesca se está comiendo su propia promesa. Décadas después, la industria ha construido una paradoja digna de unos Juegos del Hambre bajo el mar. Millones de peces salvajes terminan triturados y convertidos en alimento para otros peces que después llegan a nuestros supermercados.
Y muchas veces la ruta termina de forma drástica en Canarias.

Valve has finally released the CAD files for its Steam Frame VR headset and VR controllers, officially allowing modders and creators to create and publish their own Steam Frame accessories—as long as they're published under the correct Creative Commons Attribution Non-Commercial Share Alike 4.0 International license. The CAD files are published on GitLab, and they include both 3D models and technical drawings and documentation for reference when designing accessories. 
The CAD files also include documentation on the electronics of the Steam Frame, including an example project documenting a USB 3.0 expansion port that could be adapted for other electronics projects. The system encodes data into the ions and reads out processing results using a control device made with standard chipmaking equipment. IonQ says the device is more practical than the highly complicated, bulky lasers typically used for those tasks.
The company also competes in the cybersecurity market. Last year, it bought a Swiss startup called ID Quantique that developed a series of physical data encryption devices. Esa pieza de silicona cumple una doble función: bloquea la luz ambiental y mantiene una distancia fija entre el ojo y la cámara, lo que permite obtener imágenes de calidad diagnóstica sin intervención de un especialista en el lugar.

Announced at VMware Explore in Frankfurt, HyperArmor targets two common routes into virtualized infrastructure: stolen root credentials and unpatched vulnerabilities. It combines host-level virtual patching, controls on executable programs and scripts and multifactor authentication for remote access to VMware ESX hosts.
Broadcom executives said the product responds to attacks that are accelerating faster than enterprises can update infrastructure software.
“You don’t have enough time to triage a single alert, and you can’t apply patches at machine speed,” said Prashanth Shenoy, chief marketing officer and vice president of marketing for cloud platform, infrastructure and solutions at Broadcom.
HyperArmor operates directly at the ESX layer, which runs directly on a physical server to support virtual machines. Protecting the hypervisor is important because it undergirds all workloads that depend on that host.

Le mod HelixSR fait tourner le DLSS 3.7 de NVIDIA sur du matériel AMD, ROG Ally X et Steam Deck compris. Aucune puce NVIDIA n’est requise, mais seuls les jeux DirectX 12 sont concernés. Les premiers tests sont encourageants.
Le DLSS est depuis des années l’un des meilleurs arguments commerciaux des cartes graphiques GeForce RTX. Ce mod apporte le DLSS 3.7 aux consoles portables AMD en détournant la compatibilité FSR des jeux, là où les joueurs Radeon n’avaient jusqu’ici que les technologies maison.
HelixSR fait passer le DLSS 3.7 pour du FSR 3.1
Le principe est assez malin. Selon Windowscentral, HelixSR ne cherche pas à émuler du matériel NVIDIA : il fait croire au jeu qu’il dialogue avec le FSR 3.1 d’AMD, ce qui permet d’y brancher la reconstruction d’image du DLSS à la place.
Rappelons le mécanisme de ces technologies d’upscaling : le jeu est calculé dans une définition inférieure, par exemple en 720p, puis l’image est reconstruite en 1080p sans trop sacrifier la qualité. Le mod fonctionne sur les consoles AMD comme la ROG Ally X et le Steam Deck.
Sur le forum ResetEra, des utilisateurs ont comparé HelixSR au FSR 4. Dans l’un des tests, l’upscaling en 1080p a pris environ 7 millisecondes avec le mod, contre 11 millisecondes avec le FSR 4. L’écart compte sur une console portable, où chaque milliseconde disputée au budget d’une image se paie en fluidité.

La compañía japonesa, junto con Taisei Corporation y Taisei Rotec Corporation, desarrolló la tecnología base de un sistema que permitiría suministrar energía a los vehículos mientras circulan, sin necesidad de detenerse en una estación de carga.

La tecnología se conoce como transferencia dinámica de energía inalámbrica (DWPT, por sus siglas en inglés) y se apoya en el acoplamiento magnético sin contacto.
El sistema de carretera que carga autos eléctricos mientras avanzan combina tres elementos: una fuente de alimentación en tierra, unidades transmisoras embebidas en el pavimento y un receptor instalado en cada vehículo, que capta la energía magnética y la convierte en electricidad para la batería.
El esquema se organiza en tres partes complementarias. Taisei Corporation desarrolla el sistema de suministro eléctrico en corriente continua que alimenta toda la instalación.

articles.title: The Apple Upgrade program is great for consumers and Apple, but bad for carriers like Verizon and AT&T — here's why
articles.summary:
19 years ago, the iPhone broke the cell carrier business and built what we have today — and Apple's new Upgrade program could break it all over again
Opinion: The Apple Upgrade program is a net positive for consumers, but there are knock-on effects that could yet have a lasting impact
Where were you when the first iPhone went on sale back in 2007? I remember clearly that I was working for Phones4U — a third-party phone reseller in the UK — and the iPhone launch completely decimated the business, as suddenly Phones4U wasn't a reseller of the most popular phone on the market.
The same existential threat applied to all carriers except AT&T and O2, which had exclusive launch rights to the iPhone in the US and UK, respectively.
Fast-forward 19 years, and Apple has repeatedly proven that the iPhone's popularity gives it considerable power over its carrier partners — customers are no longer loyal to the carrier providing the mobile service, but to the brand behind their favorite phone.
Apple's newest commercial venture, the Apple Upgrade program — which was announced earlier this year and is, at the time of writing, still only available in the US — is the latest dagger to the heart of major MNOs (Mobile Network Operators).
But despite being a fantastic deal for customers and Apple itself (and make no mistake: I believe it's a net positive move), the Apple Upgrade program could yet prove a double-edged sword for the mobile industry as a whole. Let me explain.

articles.title: Amazon partage avec les entreprises les outils inspirés de son million de robots, la France en bonne place
articles.summary:
Amazon Web Services a lancé sa Physical AI Toolchain, une boîte à outils open source pour concevoir des robots dotés d'IA physique. Une étude sur la discipline classe la France parmi les marchés « en accélération », mais pointe des clients encore frileux.
Depuis le 8 octobre, Amazon Web Services met à disposition des entreprises sa Physical AI Toolchain, une boîte à outils d'IA physique nourrie de l'expérience d'Amazon et de sa flotte de plus d'un million de robots. La promesse belle, puisque la solution open source a été conçue, avec NVIDIA d'ailleurs, pour aider les entreprises à lancer leurs propres machines intelligentes, capables de percevoir, de raisonner et d'agir, en quelques semaines plutôt qu'en plusieurs années. Mais l'étude publiée dans la foulée par l'entreprise dessine un tableau plus nuancé, où le frein n'est pas forcément la technologie et où la France se distingue, dans un sens comme dans l'autre.
IA physique : AWS ouvre la boîte à outils de ses robots
L’IA physique, c’est l’intelligence artificielle qui sort de l’écran pour piloter des robots, des drones ou des machines industrielles. Grâce à leurs caméras et à leurs capteurs, ces machines perçoivent ce qui les entoure et adaptent leurs gestes. Pour aider les industriels à en concevoir, des usines aux entrepôts, AWS découpe le travail en étapes. articles.title: Cómo convertir un documento de más de 100 páginas en PDF sin instalar aplicaciones
articles.summary:
Digitalizar más de 100 páginas físicas desde el teléfono ya no requiere instalar aplicaciones adicionales ni pagar por planes premium. WhatsApp y Google Drive permiten convertir documentos en archivos PDF en Android y iPhone, con opciones para capturar, ordenar, editar y compartir cada página.
Estas herramientas son útiles para transformar recibos, facturas, contratos, apuntes o informes en archivos portátiles. El proceso permite reunir muchas hojas en un único PDF, enviarlo desde el celular o guardarlo en la nube, sin recurrir a programas de origen desconocido que puedan solicitar permisos innecesarios.
Cómo escanear más de 100 páginas desde la app de WhatsApp
La función de escáner está integrada en el menú de adjuntos del chat desde el que se desea enviar el archivo. El usuario debe tocar el ícono del clip, elegir “Documento” y buscar la opción “Escanear documento”, que aparece en la parte inferior de la pantalla.
Al activar esa alternativa, la cámara del teléfono pasa al modo escáner. Cada hoja puede incorporarse al mismo documento antes de enviarlo, una opción útil para contratos extensos, formularios administrativos, carpetas de estudio o comprobantes que deben permanecer agrupados.
La aplicación ofrece dos formas de captura. En el modo automático, el sistema reconoce los contornos de la hoja, los marca con un recuadro verde y toma la imagen cuando detecta que el teléfono se encuentra estable. Esta modalidad permite avanzar con rapidez al digitalizar documentos de muchas…

articles.title: Homebrew App Brings Xbox Cloud Gaming to Jailbroken PS5s
articles.summary:
Monday, October 12th 2026
Homebrew App Brings Xbox Cloud Gaming to Jailbroken PS5s
Jailbroken PS5 owners can now stream Xbox games on Sony's console. Developer RafaelNGP has released PSBox Cloud Gaming on GitHub, an unofficial Xbox Cloud Gaming client that runs natively on homebrew-enabled PS5s through a loader such as ShadowMountPlus. Sign-in works through a code entered at microsoft.com/link, and a Game Pass Ultimate subscription is still required. The DualSense acts as an Xbox controller, rumble included, and the latest build even adds voice chat through the DualSense mic. Streams run at 1080p60 by default, with 720p for slower connections and an experimental 1440p mode where Microsoft offers it. Interestingly, the app can also use the PS5's GPU to upscale the stream to 4K, with a choice between AMD FSR 1 and the Anime4K upscaler.
The project is moving fast, too. Version 0.5.0, which brought the 4K upscaling, landed on October 8, and version 0.9.5 followed just two days later, picking up Remote Play to your own Xbox along the way. Video is H.264 decoded on the CPU, so there's no HDR for now, and bitrate sits at around 10 to 12 Mbps at 1080p. Some early testers reportedly ran into macroblocking, pink artifacts, and DualSense vibration issues. It's the latest in a busy stretch for PS5 homebrew, following emulators that run Nintendo Switch games, load PS2 discs, and even get Halo 2 running on the console. articles.title: I found the parry-focused swordplay of Valor Mortis incredibly satisfying, but this clash of Souls-like and first-person adventure isn't as sharp as it could be

The snappy and satisfying parry-focused combat of Valor Mortis will surely delight fans of Sekiro and Lies of P who are looking for a ‘Souls-like’ experience from a new perspective. - + Gruesome world and creature designs
Reasons to avoid

- - Some dull and frustrating environments
- - Too reliant on traps and trickery
- - Not a huge variety of weapons and powers
Why you can trust TechRadar
